description: Use this when an actor asks to learn my lines, run lines or get off book; choose a personal task for their stated cue listening, memorization, cold read or selftape preflight need. Also use for an existing theatre or film/TV production cast's preparation, or an agent's or manager's clients' everyday rehearsal and audition preparation. Match the goal to the group and use their available days and daily minutes; label omitted values as examples. Accepts bounded planning metadata only. Do not use for casting decisions, private script import, rehearsal surveillance, account access, saved sessions or subscription purchases; it does not judge readiness or grant access.

actor_count.description: Number of cast members or represented clients; omit for an individual actor

daily_minutes.description: Minutes each actor/client can practise daily, from 5 to 90; omit for a labeled 20-minute example. Every routine totals this time.

days_available.description: Available practice days, supplied by the user; an omitted value produces a clearly labeled seven-day example

deadline.description: Real deadline date, for example 2026-10-12. Recorded as context only; does not calculate days_available or guarantee readiness. Supply available practice days separately.

goal.description: personal_lines for an individual actor learning or running lines; theatre_rehearsal for an existing theatre cast; production_cast_preparation for an existing film/TV production cast; agency_client_preparation for agents/managers supporting represented clients. Casting candidates use personal_lines, not shared cast preparation.

languages.description: Script/practice languages, for example [en, da]; omit for a labeled English example. These are planning preferences, not automatic translations or proof of published audio.

personal_task.description: For personal_lines only: cue_listening for missed partner cues; memorization for exact line recall; cold_read for unfamiliar material; self_tape_preflight for rehearsal and landscape camera checks. Use only the actor's stated need; omit for the general routine. Never infer readiness.

production_count.description: Number of existing productions; omit for an individual or agency routine. This does not create productions or casting calls.

rights_status.description: The user's stated permission to use/share/voice material. This is planning context, not a rights or account-access verification.

script_status.description: The user's stated script status: approved material ready, material still needing review, or no material. This tool does not inspect or verify a script.
